{{Conjecture|legends}}
Part of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], this '''group''' was composed primarily of [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]] and a [[Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|Recusant-class light destroyer]]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], this group attacked the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] controlled [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Biniir/Legends|Ord Biniir]] in what would later be known as the [[First Battle of Ord Biniir]]. The group managed to capture the planet for the Alliance and defeat the [[233rd Imperial Fighter Group]].
